title: Black Whale tier blockout
purpose: Convert the five Phase 7.3 diagrammatic tier bands into evidence-labeled internal macro-volumes without inventing rooms, routes, deck counts, or exact metric boundaries.
charter: Tier geometry is a working visualization and never becomes evidence.
The canonical cutaway supports broad vertical order and envelope relationships, not exact deck heights or floor counts.
Unknown space remains visibly unknown and non-navigable.
Interstitial bands remain separate containers rather than being silently assigned to neighboring tiers.
No room, corridor, stair, lift, doorway, shaft, or access route is authorized by this phase.
Contradictions and unresolved tier assignments remain quarantined.

interstitialPolicy.rule: Maintain explicit unknown or interstitial bands between major tier masses where the spatial graph distinguishes them; do not merge these bands into a tier for visual convenience.

futureRoomModuleDirection.description: Future hero rooms should present as removable open-wall cutaway diorama modules nested within their supported tier context.
futureRoomModuleDirection.phaseBoundary: Detailed room modules belong to later hero-room production and must not be started in Phase 7.4.
designRequirements: Unseen walls and closure surfaces are marked reconstructed.
Unknown portions remain blank, neutral, translucent, or suppressed.
Temporary occupants, damage, guards, and Nen effects remain chapter-state overlays rather than permanent geometry.

roadmapBoundary: Phase 7.5 and all later milestones are prohibited until explicit user instruction after Phase 7.4 completion.
